hero.headline: Build a Business That Honors
hero.subhead: Your business is a mission field. We help faith-driven leaders build cultures that form people, not just drive performance.

benefits.text: Tend The Souls In Your Organization

whoIWorkWith.label: Who I Work With
whoIWorkWith.headline: Leaders Who Know Their Business Was Made for More.
whoIWorkWith.body: If you're carrying the weight of your organization's culture — and quietly wondering if there's someone who can help you tend the souls in your care, not just the systems — you're exactly who this is for.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.headline: You Can Build a Thriving Business and Still Lose Your People.
problem.body: Metrics don't shepherd hearts. Systems don't tend souls. If you sense there's more — for your people, your culture, your calling — PurposeBound Strategies was built for you.

meetTory.label: Meet Tory
meetTory.headline: Hi, I'm Tory.
meetTory.body: Kingdom-minded catalyst, coach, and sales leader — led six, million-dollar producers, high school and collegiate athletes, 34 leaders taken from their desks to the mission field, and 25 years living at the intersection of faith and excellence.
meetTory.quote: "For 25 years I've watched leaders build thriving organizations while slowly losing what matters most. That gap is exactly where I work."

steps.title: Let's Talk
steps.body: A candid conversation about where your organization is, where you sense it's called to go, and whether Tory is the right fit for that journey. No pitch — just discernment.

steps.title: Walk Together
steps.body: An engagement shaped around your people, your culture, and the specific work God seems to be calling your organization into.

steps.title: Stop Building Alone
steps.body: Ongoing presence, accountability, and equipping — because the most meaningful work isn't meant to be done in isolation.

items.name: 25+ Years Building Leaders, Teams, and Kingdom Impact | 250+ People Developed

callout.headline: The Workplace Is a Mission Field.
callout.body: The question isn't whether your organization is forming the people in it — it's what it's forming them into.

banner.label: Ministry in the Marketplace
banner.headline: Faith Doesn't Stop at the Office Door.
banner.subline: 34 leaders brought from their desks to the mission field — and back again, changed.

whatIBelieve.label: What I Believe
whatIBelieve.quote: A business is a discipleship environment. The question isn't whether you're forming your team — it's what you're forming them into.
